protocol.crop: same central 1200x1200 ACSGGCT crop for every method
protocol.spatial_protocol: cells 0/1/2: WPDC fitting/threshold/final test; baselines use no labels
protocol.artificial_stars: same fixed scenes for all methods; 2x20 stars per magnitude/density stratum
protocol.photutils_artificial_detection: shares the identical DAOStarFinder candidate frontend; PSF fitting affects measurement, not proposal recovery
protocol.spatial_epsf_joint: quadrant image-only empirical PSFs and two neighbour-aware coordinate/flux fitting passes; it remains a separate operating point until the full controlled run is assessed
